verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a scraping API/service (not itself an agent), so publishing an official MCP server is a valid axis; a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at mcp.scrapingbee.com. However, there is no first-party documentation detail on the MCP server's tool set, setup, or independent/community corroboration of it working. Missing for 10: detailed official docs on MCP server capabilities/setup, independent hands-on confirmation.
